'''Skywalker wine''' was a beverage that shared its name with the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker family]].<ref name="LYC" />

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I always thought Skywalker name was somewhat unique? <small>[Sic]</small>''"<br />"''No, no, no, there's even the Skywalker wine.|Jon Stewart and George Lucas at Celebration V|<ref name="SWCME:PbP">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/jon_stewart_george_lucas_main_event/index.html|text=''Star Wars'' Celebration Main Event: Play by Play}}</ref>}}
''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] first mentioned Skywalker wine during [[Celebration V]], when asked by [[Jon Stewart]] about the rarity of the name Skywalker, as an example of the name's relative ubiquity.<ref name="SWCME:PbP" />

This was likely intended as a reference to [[Wikipedia:Francis Ford Coppola|Francis Ford Coppola's]] Viandante del Cielo ("Walker of the Sky" in Italian) wine, which is made from grapes grown on [[Skywalker Ranch]].<ref name="Slashfilm">{{WebCite|url=http://www.slashfilm.com/2010/02/08/geek-deal-25-off-skywalker-ranch-wine|text=Geek Deal: 25% Off Skywalker Ranch Wine|work=Slashfilm|archivedate=20101024152611}}</ref> While Lucas also likely intended the existence of actual Skywalker wine in-universe to be a joke, [[Leland Chee]], keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database]], added it as a [[canon]]ical beverage to the database.<ref name="LYC" />

As shown in [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Wikipedia:Instagram|Instagram]] account, George Lucas visited the filming set as a birthday surprise for him during production of [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian|''The Mandalorian'']]. In one of Favreau's photos, it could be seen him and Lucas resting on a table with a bottle of wine with "Skywalker" written on it, suggesting that the Skywalker wine has been actually made from since.<ref name="George's There!">{{Instagram|username=jonfavreau|url=p/BpIRkFABs8W|name=[[Jon Favreau]]|date=2018-10-19|archivefile=File:The_Mandalorian_Favreau_Lucas_Instagram.png}}</ref>
